description: Autheo TaaS: tokenization, compliant trading, DvP settlement and cross-chain movement for banks and institutions.
footer: Planning documents. Not an offer of securities or a regulated service.

docs.title: North star
docs.summary: Pick an asset and a chain — Autheo handles the rest. Non-custodial by design; Lumenco physical verification; MCP tools.

docs.title: How it works
docs.summary: One asset from term sheet to second coupon: actors, objects, state machines, failure handling, what lives on-chain.

docs.title: DEX integration
docs.summary: One rulebook for issuance and trading: lifecycle, interfaces, bank roles, liquidity, revenue, joint roadmap.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.summary: Layers from licensed partners to Autheo L1 and the L0 Mesh, and which Autheo product supplies each.

docs.title: Institutional flows
docs.summary: Seven end-to-end flows from onboarding to the regulator's audit check, with the calls behind each.

docs.title: Compliance model
docs.summary: Who holds which licence, what Autheo enforces, and the rules checked on every movement.

docs.title: Security
docs.summary: Post-quantum signatures and TLS, strength profiles per institution, zkTLS proof of reserves.

docs.title: Roadmap
docs.summary: Five phases over two to three years, engineering and commercial side by side, with open questions.

docs.title: Build plan
docs.summary: Containers, repository layout, milestones M0–M6 with exit tests, testing strategy, first six weeks.

docs.title: Economics
docs.summary: Indicative revenue computed from stated inputs: one reference asset and three portfolio scenarios.

docs.title: Decisions & risks
docs.summary: Ten open decisions with options and recommendations, twelve risks with triggers and owners, the premortem.
